plan.vision: A strict Spec Roadmap detailing the exact Agentic problem, atomic milestones, and Testing Strategy. The HNContentFilterAgent will identify and flag AI-generated content on Hacker News, providing a user-friendly interface to filter such content. Atomic milestones include: 1. Implementing a basic text analysis module, 2. Integrating with the Hacker News API, 3. Developing a user interface for filtering, and 4. Creating a comprehensive test suite. The testing strategy will focus on unit tests for each component and integration tests for the entire system.
plan.lessons_learned: This project avoids past mistakes by using memory-mapped files for efficient data handling, prioritizing algorithmic efficiency over OOP overhead, and ensuring that all dependencies are pinned in a virtual environment. The repository will be kept lightweight by excluding heavy directories with .gitignore, and clear setup scripts will be provided for reproducibility. Additionally, the project will focus on security and isolation, ensuring that the code executed within the sandbox cannot access or modify external resources. There are no hidden paid-API dependencies.
plan.commit_message: Implement a content filtering agent for Hacker News to identify and flag AI-generated articles.

files_to_generate.instructions: Implement a function `analyze_text` that takes a string of text and returns a boolean indicating whether the text is likely as AI-generated. Use simple heuristics and NLP techniques available in the Python standard library.

Implement functions `get_hn_stories` to fetch stories from the Hacker News API and `flag_story` to flag a story as AI-generated. Ensure the functions are robust and handle API rate limits and errors gracefully.

Implement a command-line interface to display and filter stories. The `display_stories` function should print stories in a readable format, and `filter_stories` should allow users to filter out AI-generated stories.

Write a comprehensive test suite that includes unit tests for `text_analysis`, `hn_api_integration`, and `user_interface`. Ensure that the tests cover all edge cases and validate the functionality of the system.
Create a .gitignore file to exclude venv, __pycache__, and .env files from version control.
Document the architecture, installation steps, and usage instructions for the HNContentFilterAgent. Include details on how to run the tests and any other relevant information.
